meta.title: JOOPS — clean up space together
meta.description: Adopt a space robot and help clean up Earth's orbit. Play free in your browser.

onboarding.title: Adopt your joop
onboarding.subtitle: Enter an invite code to receive your joop, or leave your email for one.
onboarding.joined: You're on the list! We'll send an invite code soon.

joop.title: Your joop
joop.hint: Collect debris to level up, then book a launch vehicle.
joop.hintQueued: Your seat is confirmed. Start the launch sequence.
joop.hintOrbit: You're in orbit. Check your status on the space map.

minigame.title: Ground training
minigame.briefBody: In orbit your joop has to judge what is safe to pick up. Catch the falling space debris, but dodge satellites that are still on duty.
minigame.hint: Drag left and right to move your joop (arrow keys work too).
minigame.rules: {lives} satellite hits end the drill. Time limit {seconds}s.

launch.title: Book a launch
launch.subtitle: You are level {level}. Meet the required level and your seat is confirmed automatically.

arcade.title: Orbit cleanup arcade
arcade.briefBody: You're linked with {name}. Take direct control and clean up orbital debris — every piece counts toward the global cleanup and rankings.
arcade.ruleJoystick: Touch anywhere to summon the joystick — five rings fine-tune your thrust.
arcade.ruleFuel: Thrusting burns gas. Run dry and the link ends — grab ⛽ pickups to refuel!
arcade.ruleWorld: There's inertia and no friction. Fly far and you'll pass the Moon and the Sun.
arcade.reasonFuel: You ran out of thruster gas.
arcade.savedBody: Added to the global cleanup and rankings. Lifetime total: {total} pieces!
arcade.locked: Passing through shadow — the arcade opens when you're back in the link zone
arcade.shadowNotice: You're passing through shadow. Downlink returns in T-{mm}:{ss} — wait it out, or pay {cost} XP to link right now.
arcade.insufficientXp: Not enough XP (need {cost}, you have {xp}). Earn more in ground training.

space.title: Space map
space.collectedWhileAway: Collected {n} pieces while you were away.
space.hint: In Earth's shadow your joop auto-collects debris. It counts toward the ranking.
space.passInfo: Orbital phase runs {speed}× faster than real time (game speed). Altitude and speed are real values.
space.returnEarthConfirm: Really return? Tap again to confirm
space.returnEarthNote: Your pieces, XP and level are kept. To fly again, book a new launch!

rankings.title: Full rankings
rankings.hint: Ranked by lifetime pieces collected. Weekly change compares with 7 days ago.

install.title: INSTALL // JOOPS
install.body: Add JOOPS to your home screen and play full-screen, like a real console.

iosSafari.lead: You can install JOOPS right from Safari:
iosSafari.step1: Tap the Share button at the bottom of Safari (the square with an arrow).
iosSafari.step2: Scroll down and tap "Add to Home Screen".
iosSafari.step3: Tap "Add" in the top corner — JOOPS will appear on your home screen.

iosOther.lead: This browser can't add JOOPS to your home screen on iOS. It only takes a moment in Safari:
iosOther.step2: Open Safari and paste the address to visit JOOPS.
iosOther.step3: Tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen".

install.generic: Open your browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" (or "Install app") to install JOOPS.

update.title: UPDATE // READY
update.body: A new version of JOOPS is ready. Update now to get the latest mission data.
